prompt_preview:
Decide whether the proposal deck addresses the client requirement below.

STATUS (choose exactly one):
- "Covered": the slides commit to ALL parts of the requirement. Different wording is fine.
- "Partially covered": the slides commit to SOME parts, but at least one part is missing.
- "Not covered":

response.evidence: Develop a sequenced three-year roadmap structured into distinct execution waves.
response.reasoning: The slides commit to creating a three-year roadmap (Slide 7 and 11), but they do not provide or commit to including investment estimates broken down by year.
